Question: How a CEO of a startup "doesn't take a salary" yet is remodeling their home and leasing a Mercedes?

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a lemonade stand. You are the boss, and you don’t take any money from the lemonade sales right now. Instead, you tell yourself, “I’ll get my money later when the stand is super successful!”

But, you really want a new toy car and a bigger playhouse. So, you use the money that people promise to give you when your lemonade stand becomes HUGE. Maybe someone says, “If your stand does really well, I’ll give you money!” You use those “maybe” promises to buy the toy car and start building the playhouse.

But right now, you aren’t actually taking money from the lemonade stand. You’re using the promises and the hope that soon you’ll have lots of money. That’s kind of like what some startup bosses do—they use the idea that their company will be worth a lot of money to buy nice things, even though they aren’t taking a real paycheck yet.
